title: Paloma and the Playlist
author: Sebastian Ravensworth
blurb: Quentin Iversen, the new kid at a school built over something old, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the last game of the season.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
